svg.title: Ratchet rotation, then velocity rotation
svg.desc: The pattern from the EXPRESSION figure, rotated twice. Ratchet rotation 10% moves each of the five ratchets to the next eligible slot, and the slots are ranked again. On that result, velocity rotation 20% gives each slot the velocity of the slot three before it: beat 3's 8.3 V moves to beat 4, and the unheard 8.8 V of resting beat 5 lands on a hit in beat 6.
